dedupe_keys.name: sdnic synchronized water pressure process and network benchmark

description: This repository publishes synchronized water-pressure process and network records for industrial-control intrusion-detection research. Its own dataset document describes two normal sessions and eight attack scenarios, with process CSV columns for Unix time, scaled pressure, valve state, pump state and labels. Packet captures record Modbus/TCP traffic, and the documentation explains joining process readings and per-second network statistics. The synthetic or testbed-scale pressure loop has no stated real-world location or calendar observation period. Current GitHub files are publicly available under CC BY 4.0. The linked Zenodo archive is restricted and lists no public files, so GitHub is the verified access route. A limitation is inconsistent metadata: the overview claims ten paired sessions, but the table and tree omit an A1 process CSV; reported row counts also exceed stated seconds in several nominally one-second sessions. Those discrepancies were not resolved by downloading data. Simulation uses include validating cross-layer monitoring against known process and communication disturbances. It complements data-tennessee-eastman-process-anomaly-detection with network captures and a smaller water-control process. Detection rules and field definitions are published, but neither tools nor attacks were executed.
name: SDNIC synchronized water-pressure process and network benchmark
notes: G8; G8-0351. G8; own metadata and documentation checked. Data files, archives and software execution were not inspected. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.
